sloka: युक्ता रामस्य भवती धर्मपत्नी यशस्विनी ।प्रतिसन्दिश मां देवि गमिष्ये यत्र राघवः ।। ६.११६.४८ ।।
transliteration: yuktā rāmasya bhavatī dharmapatnī yaśasvinī ।pratisandiśa māṁ devi gamiṣye yatra rāghavaḥ ।। 6.116.48 ।।

translations.english: "Rakshasas by nature are cruel in their deeds and can assume any form according to their will. No sinful actions to be done even if they do sinful actions."
